title: Who keeps standing between us in our photos?
description:
My sister and I hadn't spoken in two years. At our cousin's wedding, Mum asked for one thing: a photo of the two of us from the old booth in the hotel hall.

Every strip that came out had something in it that wasn't us. At first it was only a hand.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: How many marks were on the back of the last strip?
